traits.note: Jepson's Manual of the Flowering Plants of California (1925), read in full: calyx tubular, cleft down one side into 5 unequal lobes; petals filiform, 5 or 4; stamens 2 or 3; ovary free from the calyx. The Flora of North America (as quoted in search results; the page itself was not read): flowers bilaterally symmetric; hypanthium tubular; petals 4; stamens 3; ovary superior.
